medallion.name: Waymo
medallion.claim: The only fully driverless paid service at scale: about half a million rides a week across 11 US metros (mid-2026).

medallion.name: Baidu Apollo Go
medallion.claim: Largest robotaxi operation on earth by cumulative rides: 22M+ across 27 cities, and the most international (Apr 2026).

medallion.name: Tesla
medallion.claim: Largest vision-only fleet feeding one training loop; a metro-wide Austin map served by about 20 unsupervised cars (Jul 2026).

medallion.name: Zoox
medallion.claim: First purpose-built robotaxi with no controls to carry public riders; free everywhere pending a federal exemption.

medallion.name: Pony.ai
medallion.claim: First to claim city-level unit-economics breakeven, in Shenzhen and Guangzhou; 1,700+ robotaxis (May 2026).

medallion.name: WeRide
medallion.claim: Licensed in eight countries, the broadest regulatory footprint of any operator, and the Gulf's driverless leader.

medallion.name: Wayve
medallion.claim: Map-light end-to-end driving licensed to OEMs and fleets; $1.2B Series D, London trials with Uber during 2026.

medallion.name: Nuro
medallion.claim: Pivoted from delivery pods to licensing its driver; now powering Uber's 35,000-vehicle Lucid robotaxi programme.

medallion.name: May Mobility
medallion.claim: Constrained-ODD transit and campus autonomy: 3.5M+ rides across the US and Japan, live on Lyft in Atlanta.

medallion.name: Motional
medallion.claim: Hyundai-backed and factory-integrated; IONIQ 5 robotaxis relaunched on Uber in Las Vegas, March 2026.
